brief: post for the opening of my bakery this saturday
concept: The smell you'll wake up to: the first tray out of the oven at 6 am.
plan_outline: 1. Still · 45° · window light at dawn · a tray of golden croissants just out of the oven, steam rising (the cover)
2. Still · top · flour-dusted wooden table · hands shaping dough, flour in the air
3. Still · eye · storefront at blue hour · the shop's windows lit warm, the street still dark
4. Card (page) · 'Opening Saturday · 6 am' with the logo on the brand's cream colour
why: A carousel's first image is its hook: the most appetising frame, not the logo.
Dawn light ties the set together and says 'early, fresh' without words.
The date and time go on a designed card, exactly as the user gave them; no invented offers.
